Dark: Once per game, may ▼ [Episode VII] Emperor here.” '''Errata mark:''' this image prints no errata mark but is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' The same day the PC re-uploaded the card turned 90° to landscape, the way location cards are shown (holotable 703095c, “Rotate locations”, PNG 980×703; then 611e293, “virtual 14”, the same PNG again and the first GIF copy, 745×534). Words, art and layout unchanged. A rotated re-upload is a version (Bill, 12 November 2026, 18:48).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Exegol: Sith Throne (Errata 2)]]): '''First published 31 May 2022''' as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Dark/hires/exegolsiththrone.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/13a5f3a50444b0b953aad90805681777b4241fbb commit 13a5f3a]); the card-size image cited next is a later copy of the same image (a version is dated by its first publication in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). [Light Side] icons are canceled here. Your characters deploy +2 here. Dark: Once per game, may ▼ [Episode VII] Emperor here.” '''Errata mark:''' this image prints no errata mark but is errata 2 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' The PC re-rendered the card (holotable 13a5f3a, “Hires sets 4, 14, 16, couple AIs”, 31 May 2022: PNG 1039×745; GIF copy e8445f0, “Fixing case and making gifs”, 1 June 2022, still 745×534). Most visibly: the line down the right border “Artwork not affiliated or endorsed by Lucasfilm Ltd” became “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.” in small capitals; the [Episode VII] icon moved from above the Set 14 icon at the lower left to the left border beside the art; the art credit now ends “@ ArtStation” (was “@ ArtStation.com”); art, frame and icons render slightly differently. Words unchanged. This image was first published on 31 May 2022 as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Dark/hires/exegolsiththrone.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/13a5f3a50444b0b953aad90805681777b4241fbb commit 13a5f3a]); the card-size GIF uploaded 11 June 2022 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6894629d2267392808e0be34eb4aaa7686eced2c commit 6894629], earlier listed as its own version, PC-E3) is a later copy of the same image in another format, so it is not a new version (a version is one distinct image, dated when it was first published in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026).
